WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT category, 
         AVG(CASE WHEN spent = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (spent - amount) / CAST(amount AS REAL) END) as avg_ratio, 
         COUNT(*) as cnt 
  FROM budget 
  GROUP BY category
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT step1.category, step1.avg_ratio, step1.cnt, step1.cnt - step2.avg_cnt as diff
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step1.cnt > step2.avg_cnt
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as final_avg_ratio,
       AVG(cnt) as final_avg_cnt,
       AVG(diff) as final_avg_diff
FROM step3    -- The three values: average overspend ratio for categories above-average-volume (-0.0514), average record count (18.5), and average excess count (8.1)
